Resolves #19772

A grid's locked bodies and locked header toolbars now carry the configs of their center counterparts, for 13.3 (milestone v13.3). With #19774 on `dev`, that includes animated row sorting: a sort moves each record's locked and center rows together. `examples/grid/animatedRowSorting` now locks its Id column to show it, and an e2e test proves it in the browser.

Since the multi-body layout (#9487, 2026-03-31), `grid.Container#createOrUpdateSubGrids` and `grid.header.Wrapper#updateHeaders` built the locked instances from `...instance.initialConfig`, a property nothing assigns. So every locked column lost the grid's `body` and `headerToolbar` configs: no header filters, no sorting options, no row animation, no modified-cell highlighting.

- `Neo.cloneNeoInstance(instance, config)` takes an optional override object now. The engine's clone from `originalConfig`, without `_id` and `id`, is the record these sites meant to read. Its contract, including the construction-only boundary, is the [Contract Ledger on #19772](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19772); the JSDoc states that boundary.
- Both sites clone the center instance, with `reference: null` and the region's own `parent`, `store`, `theme` and items. A locked body also keeps the center body's class (a custom body subclass, where the old code always built a plain `GridBody`). `Wrapper.mjs` no longer imports `Toolbar`.
- Net source: +40/−53 lines.

Related: #9487 (introduced the spread) · #6858 / #19774 (where it surfaced; merged) · #9486 (Grid Multi-Body) · #6951 (`Neo.cloneMap`)

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on real grids, mounted vdom, real config resolution) for AC-1 to AC-4, and L3 (real Chromium, real App Worker, the e2e engine tier) for AC-4 → L3 required for AC-4: the motion of a locked row is what a user sees, and grid changes ship with a browser test that shows why they are needed.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the Shared PR Baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs` › "each locked body carries the grid's body configs": `bodyStart` and `bodyEnd` read `animatedRowSorting` and `highlightModifiedCells` as true, and all three bodies load the AnimateRows plugin. |
| AC-2 | › "each locked header toolbar carries the grid's header toolbar configs": `headerStart` and `headerEnd` read `showHeaderFilters: true`, `sortable: false` and `useTriStateSorting: true`. |
| AC-3 | › "a locked instance keeps its own identity and placement": three distinct body ids and three distinct toolbar ids, `reference` null on every locked instance, a locked body's `parentId` is the view and its `store` the grid's, `layoutLock` is `start` / `end`. The bodies are the center body's custom subclass. |
| AC-4 | › "with animatedRowSorting, the locked bodies move every record with the center body": after a sort by name, all three bodies show each displayed record at the same row index, offset and opacity after the first step (Row 10 at its previous offset 400, Row 14 entering transparent at 240), after the second (Row 10 at 80, Row 14 opaque) and once settled. In the browser, `AnimatedRowSorting.spec.mjs` › "a sort moves each row of the locked Id column with its center row" samples Amanda's locked row and her center row on every frame of a Firstname sort. The locked row starts at 160, passes between and ends at 0, and in no frame is it more than half a row from the center row. |
| AC-5 | Unit, component and e2e suites green (below). |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The mechanism.** The ticket proposed spreading `originalConfig`. `Neo.cloneNeoInstance` already does exactly that (minus the ids), so it gained the override argument and both sites call it. Its one existing caller, `Neo.clone`, passes no override and is unchanged; the clone test now goes through it too.
- **More now carries over:** any `listeners`, `cls` or `style` in the grid's `body` or `headerToolbar` config reaches the locked instances too, as the other configs do. `reference` does not.
- **`Neo.clone`'s `ignoreNeoInstances` (pre-existing, #6951):** `Neo.clone` hands `cloneMap.NeoInstance` its `deep` flag in that slot, so `Neo.clone(instance, true)` returns the same instance and `Neo.clone(instance, false, true)` a new one. `originalConfig` (`true, true`) shares nested instances either way, so this fix is unaffected. Recorded in the ledger and left out of scope: with the default `ignoreNeoInstances=false`, a fix would make every deep `Neo.clone` copy the instances nested in it.
- **AC-4 needed #19774.** `7e01312043` merges `dev` once #19774 was on it; the arm follows.
- **The example locks its Id column** (`7c07b98906`), so the e2e test has a locked region to drive. Since that example now renders two bodies, the spec's helpers read only the center body (rows with a Firstname cell), and its readiness wait targets the center body's `neo-animate-rows`. `5d7b764881` merges `dev` first, which brought that readiness wait (#19781).
- **The pre-commit formatter** aligned the new spec; the commits hold its output.

## Test Evidence

- **Red first, the configs:** with only the three source files stashed, `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs` fails 4/4 (locked bodies false, toolbars false, plain `GridBody`, and `cloneNeoInstance` ignoring the override); with them, 4/4 pass.
- **Red first, AC-4:** on #19774's head with this ticket's three source files reverted, the arm fails because the locked bodies never load the plugin. With that precondition dropped, it fails on the alignment itself: the locked start body shows Row 10 at its new offset (80) while the center body animates it from 400.
- **Red first, in the browser:** with this ticket's three source files reverted to `dev`, the new e2e test fails 3/3. Amanda's locked row reads `160, 160, 160, 160, 160, 0, …`: it jumps while her center row animates. The spec's three center-body tests stay green (9/9), so the red is exactly what this fix adds. With the fix, the spec passes 40/40 over 10 repeats.
- **Premise probe** before filing, on `dev` at `7f0856c106`: `body.initialConfig` is `undefined`; the center body's `originalConfig` holds `parentId, store, theme, animatedRowSorting, highlightModifiedCells`.
- **At `7c07b98906`, Playwright 1.64 / Chromium 156:** `AnimatedRowSorting.spec.mjs` 40/40 over 10 repeats; unit 5211 passed, 2 skipped; e2e engine tier 275 passed, 3 skipped. Components last ran locally at `c8bf01f807`; the commits since change no component under test except through the `dev` merge, and CI runs that suite at this head.
- **At `f78119ac90`:** `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs` 5/5 (`--repeat-each=3` → 15/15); unit suite 5204 passed, 2 skipped.
- **At `c8bf01f807`,** which differs only by the JSDoc and the `Neo.clone` assertion: `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs` `--repeat-each=5` → 25/25; unit 5204 passed; components 451 passed; e2e engine tier 274 passed, 3 skipped (the Brain-gated specs run in CI).

|---|---|
